*The earth beneath them had turned to mud, staining the fabric of their already too-tight trousers, revealing the undeniable evidence of their unraveling restraint. A shuddering breath, a final, breaking point—there would be no holding back now.*

“So cold.. So helpless... So.. Mine. Let me...”
